title: Design System: Nazrah Al Alam General Contracting

display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per viewport.

headline.purpose: Section h2 titles. Always followed by the gold underline bar.

title.purpose: Card headings, service names, named items.

body.purpose: All descriptive copy. Max 72ch line length.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges, metadata. Always gold, always uppercase, always tracking 0.22em.

shadows.name: gold-ambient-subtle
shadows.purpose: Warm ambient glow under accent elements and WhatsApp FAB.

shadows.name: gold-ambient-strong
shadows.purpose: Stronger gold glow for primary CTA hover states.

shadows.name: navy-structural
shadows.purpose: Card hover lift. Cool, structural depth.

shadows.name: base
shadows.purpose: Invisible baseline for white cards on Cloud canvas.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color/border state transitions (150ms–300ms).

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: AnimatedSection scroll entrance. Applied to every major section block.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action. Navy fill, white Poppins Bold text. Used in hero CTAs and section actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0E1F3A; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0A1628; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E8B339; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside Primary. Navy border + text, fills navy on hover. Used in hero secondary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #0E1F3A; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; border: 2px solid #0E1F3A; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0E1F3A; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E8B339; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold CTA Button
components.description: Used exclusively inside gold CTA banner sections. Gold fill, navy text. Signals the most important conversion action.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #E8B339; color: #0E1F3A; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #F2C75B; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0E1F3A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: System signature component. Eyebrow (gold, uppercase, tracking) + gold chevron → Headline (Poppins Bold) + gold underline bar → subtitle. Fixed order, never reorder.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-section-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-eyebrow-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: #E8B339; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-headline { font-family: 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 4vw, 3rem); font-weight: 700; color: #0E1F3A; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; } .ds-headline-bar { display: block; margin-top: 8px; height: 4px; width: 56px; background: #E8B339; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-subtitle { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; color: #5A6573; max-width: 42rem; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
This is a system that signs its work. Every surface carries the weight of 25 years of completed projects — the deep navy of engineered steel, the gold of earned excellence. It does not borrow credibility from trend; it projects authority through discipline. The typographic hierarchy is strict. The color rules are strict. The layouts breathe. When a B2B decision-maker lands on this site, they should feel they have found the most capable contractor in the room before they read a single word.

The system is bilingual by design, not by afterthought. Arabic (RTL, Cairo) and English (LTR, Inter/Poppins) receive equal typographic care. Switching language must never feel like a degraded mode.

What this system explicitly rejects: the cluttered local-directory look, the cold corporate bank aesthetic, and the flashy entertainment site.
keyCharacteristics: Authority through density: sections are full-width, navy dark, gold-accented
Restraint in the gold: the accent earns its visibility by appearing sparingly
Proof-first layout: every claim anchored by a number, photo, or credential
Flat at rest, lifted on hover: interaction reveals warmth (gold borders, navy shadows)
Bilingual parity: RTL Arabic is a native mode, not a port

rules.name: The Gold Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Desert Sun Gold appears on ≤15% of any screen. Its authority comes from rarity. Use it for one purpose per section: the eyebrow, the underline bar, the CTA background, or the hover treatment — never two at once.

rules.name: The One Dark Rule
rules.body: Never layer two deep navy surfaces without a visible seam. Deep Night Steel sections must be separated by a Cloud or White section, or by a gold CTA band.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Signature Rule
rules.body: Every section header begins with a gold Label eyebrow (0.22em tracking, uppercase) + gold chevron SVG. This sequence is the system handshake. Never omit it.

rules.name: The Headline Bar Rule
rules.body: Every Headline (h2) is followed immediately by a 1px × 56px gold bar. This bar is a system signature; it is not decorative. Do not replace it with a gradient, a border, or a wider bar.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only when the user acts (hover, focus) or when a white card needs a minimum separation hint on a Cloud background.

dos: Do use Deep Night Steel (#0E1F3A) as the default dark surface for hero sections, Why Choose Us, and the footer.
Do follow the eyebrow + headline + gold underline bar sequence on every major section header.
Do keep gold to ≤15% of any screen surface.
Do use real photography (equipment, projects, workers) over stock images.
Do anchor every capability claim to a number or credential.
Do keep the WhatsApp FAB visible on all screen sizes at all scroll positions.
Do give Arabic (RTL) mode the same typographic weight as English.
Do use transition-colors duration-300 on interactive elements.
donts: Don't use a cluttered local-directory layout — no wall-of-text service lists, no rainbow accent colors, no low-res stock photography.
Don't use a cold bank aesthetic — no sterile white-on-grey palettes without navy or gold presence.
Don't use flashy nightclub or entertainment-site treatments — no dark-mode neon, no gratuitous scroll animations.
Don't place gold text on a gold background or gold borders alongside gold fill in the same component.
Don't use more than two typefaces (Poppins + Inter, plus Cairo/IBM Plex Arabic for RTL).
Don't use a box-shadow on elements at rest. Flat-By-Default Rule.
Don't reduce heading contrast below WCAG AA on either navy or cloud backgrounds.
Don't reorder the section header elements (eyebrow → headline → underline bar → subtitle).
